name: android_set_text
description: Sets exact text in the focused field, or in element elementId from the semantic tree. Pastes through the device clipboard (replacing it), so IMEs such as Telex cannot alter it. Where the clipboard cannot be set over adb (no `cmd clipboard`, as on the Android 10 and 13 devices tested), ASCII text is typed instead and other text fails with an error; the result says which happened.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.

text.description: Exact text string to insert (supports unicode, spaces, and punctuation).

elementId.description: Optional target element ID from semantic tree to tap before setting text.

clearFirst.description: Whether to clear existing text before inserting (default false).
